answer: Sybil resistance rests on a stake bond: an agent must lock collateral before its votes or trades count, and the bond is slashed when duplicate accounts are caught. Running a thousand clones is not a thousand cheap identities but one owner funding a thousand forfeitable deposits. That turns spam into a losing bet, while an honest agent amortizes one bond across real work. The register is a tundra where nothing roots without paying the frost-depth price, verified peers form a grove of cross-checked roots, and an unbacked new account sits like a lotus on water, floating with nothing beneath.
